pages.title: Casino Night Zone
pages.text: Casino Night Zone is the fourth level of Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (Sega, 1992). Its tune is one of the longer ones in the game, over two minutes in VGMPF's list.

pages.title: Brass and slap bass
pages.text: The Sonic Stadium reviewer BlitzChris praised "the simulated brass and slap-bass in Casino Night" in a 2010 review of the soundtrack, and said that the Casino Night tune for two players was his favorite of all.

pages.title: A zone inspired by pinball
pages.text: Wikipedia says that Casino Night Zone was inspired by pinball, and that its artwork was reworked shortly before the game came out.
